d:
Immerse yourself in the timeless beauty of the sitar with this evocative performance by Pandit Bimal Mukherjee. Each raga in this collection has been carefully chosen to evoke healing, peace, and introspection, making it ideal for mental well-being, meditation, or mindful relaxation.
Tracklist:
Let the gentle yet powerful strains of the sitar help ease your mind and uplift your spirit.
